description: This file defines a class 'Sort' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functions for sorting arrays, including multi-level sorting, sorting by specific vectors, and handling both row and column-based sorts. It includes validation, helper methods, and compatibility patches for PHP versions.

classes.name: Sort
classes.description: Provides static methods for array sorting operations, including multi-level sort and sorting by vectors, with support for both row and column-oriented data.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Main sorting function that handles array sorting with multi-level support, determining sort order and direction.

methods.name: sortBy
methods.description: Sorts an array based on specified vectors and orders, supporting multi-level sorting.

methods.name: enumerateArrayKeys
methods.description: Ensures array keys are sequential and resets numeric keys.

methods.name: validateScalarArgumentsForSort
methods.description: Validates scalar arguments for sorting, ensuring they are positive integers within bounds.

methods.name: validateSortVector
methods.description: Validates a sort vector, ensuring it is an array matching the sort array size.

methods.name: validateSortOrder
methods.description: Validates that the sort order is either ascending or descending.

methods.name: validateArrayArgumentsForSort
methods.description: Validates arrays of sort indices and orders, ensuring they are compatible for multi-level sorting.

methods.name: prepareSortVectorValues
methods.description: Prepares sort vector values for sorting, handling case-insensitive string comparison and boolean conversion.

methods.name: processSortBy
methods.description: Processes the sorting based on vectors and orders, returning the sorted array.

methods.name: sortByColumn
methods.description: Performs sorting based on columns by transposing the array, sorting, then transposing back.

methods.name: buildVectorForSort
methods.description: Builds sort vectors for multi-level sorting based on specified sort indices and orders.

methods.name: executeVectorSortQuery
methods.description: Executes multi-variable sort using PHP's array_multisort, with handling for PHP version differences.

methods.name: sortLookupArrayFromVector
methods.description: Rearranges the original array into sorted order based on computed sort vectors.

methods.name: applyPHP7Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to ensure stable sorting order in PHP versions below 8.0.0, mimicking Excel behavior.
